title: Value vs reference: the batch
prompt: Implement in `Solution`: `struct Batch { public int Count; }` and `static (int First, int Second) CopyProbe()` that creates a `Batch` with `Count = 1`, copies it to a second variable, sets the copy's `Count = 2`, and returns BOTH counts. Also `static (int First, int Second) RefProbe()` doing the same with `class BatchRef { public int Count; }`.

tests.name: struct-copies
tests.hint: Struct assignment copies: the second variable's write cannot reach the first.

tests.name: class-shares
tests.hint: Class assignment shares one object: both variables report 2 — the discriminating pair.
